[SWS_SM_00647] Enabling RequestTransition method after StopUpdateSession
call
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
Once
StopUpdateSession
method has been invoked any call to
RequestTransi-
tion
for
StateMachine
of type
Controller
shall not return
kUpdateInProgress
any longer.
⌋
